Inventya delivers this service through practical one-to-one support, helping businesses shape a business plan that is tailored to their funding and operational goals. A core part of the service is the development or refinement of the financial model that underpins the plan, ensuring that the narrative is supported by credible assumptions, key figures and financial logic. The service combines strategic review with practical development support. This includes input on structure, clarity, business model, commercial positioning, financials and next steps. The aim is to provide a concise business plan that is clear, credible and aligned with the business’s priorities, while giving the client a stronger foundation for planning, funder engagement and future growth. #Funding#Financing#FinancialAdvice#StartUpAndScaleUp#InvestmentReadiness#GrantApplications#SeedFunding#FindingTheRightFit#ProofOfConcept

De-risk & Accelerate your Automation Pro.description: Identify and resolve system integration issues before equipment delivery through a 1-month CYBERLYNK deployment This CYBERLYNK service enables manufacturers, system integrators, and OEMs to identify and resolve network-oriented system integration issues earlier in the project lifecycle, accelerating time to production and de-risking commissioning. Traditionally, network-oriented integration issues between equipment and control systems only emerge during commissioning/Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), after equipment has been delivered. This often results in project delays, unplanned costs, inefficient use of engineering resources, and extended commissioning timelines. CYBERLYNK closes this gap by enabling engineers to securely carry out pre-SAT integration testing during the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) phase.Using CYBERLYNK’s cybersecure integration device, machines and control systems can be securely & seamlessly connected and tested earlier, while remaining at their respective vendor locations. CYBERLYNK enables both point-to-point and point-to-multipoint (multi-node) fully end-to-end encrypted connections, ensuring secure communication across all connected systems.This solution operates without system reconfiguration or additional software installation. In summary, CYBERLYNK allows network-oriented integration issues to be identified and resolved before equipment arrives at the customer site, significantly reducing risk during on-site commissioning/SAT. #Technology trials#Risk-free innovation exploration#Technical training
De-risk & Accelerate your Automation Pro.duration: A one-month CYBERLYNK deployment, comprising two CYBERLYNK units, will be supported by an initial scoping session, a dedicated training session, and a concluding review meeting.
